title: Injectivity of the Baum–Connes Assembly Map
exact_target: For every discrete group $\Gamma$ and $i\in\{0,1\}$, is the Baum–Connes assembly map $\mu:K_i^\Gamma(E\Gamma)\to K_i(C_r^*(\Gamma))$ injective, where $E\Gamma$ is the universal space for proper $\Gamma$-actions?
